narrative:
Preble County has 27,845 registered voters, with 53.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 37.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 9.3%, a pronounced Republican lean of 27.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.2% of registrants.
